item.title: Apple killed open rate. Most agencies still report on it.
item.description: Since iOS 15 Mail Privacy Protection launched in 2021, roughly 60-65% of email "opens" are fake pre-loads by Apple. closed:in dropped open rate from client reports two years ago. Here is what we use instead.

item.title: The cold email warmup schedule that actually works in 2026
item.description: Skip warmup or run it wrong and your domain reputation is dead before you send the first real email. The exact 21-day warmup schedule closed:in uses on every client inbox, plus the 4 traps that wreck deliverability.

item.title: How to find prospects who are not in Apollo or ZoomInfo
item.description: Niche B2B ICPs (boutique retailers, hospitality operators, local service businesses) often do not appear in standard B2B databases. The custom data sourcing pipeline closed:in built for Jamezz that produced 81 qualified leads in 60 days.
